data.text: Permanent. On your Attack action, enemy's Block action does not cause you combat damage. Your Attack action does not trigger traps and the follow rule is not applied.

logic.description: Permanent skill played with an Attack card; lands in the permanents holding with a point-buy die of Matter (dice_count(matter) d6, highest die = power). data.text: You may use another action this turn; choose both or one for the calculations.

logic.description: Trance instant: rides on ANY real action card ('*' in the pc game, Posture on paper) and lets the caster play a second action card this turn. Per adjacent enemy the resolver picks the option (first, second, or both) that benefits the trance actor most (dealt minus taken); each Attack option hits at most one enemy, the declared target chooses first; with nobody adjacent both options are played. A countered trance collapses to its first card. Rule 8 pc override: returns to hand when the second option never improved the maths.

data.text: Counter target non-permanent skill; emit an element against the enemy, subtract the element stat from the enemy's stat.

logic.description: Instant riding on a Posture card (or an empty action) against an enemy in contact (the right-clicked one; otherwise the adjacent damaging caster it saves the most against). The target loses every non-permanent skill played this action (a trance collapses to its first card). Then the caster emits one element of the target's cast: the caster's stat for that element is subtracted from the target's stat for EVERY instance of that element in the cast before Rule 21 — effective stat per instance = max0(target_stat - caster_stat). Two counters aimed at each other resolve in actor order. Rule 8 pc override: returns to hand when nothing was stripped or saved.

prerequisites.description: The caster's action is Posture (or an empty action, which carries Posture skills).
The target is an enemy in contact.

effects.description: Amount taken off the target's stat for each instance of the countered element: the caster's own stat behind that element.
The target's effective stat for the countered element after the penalty: max0(target_stat - caster_stat).
The emitted element must be one of the elements of the target's cast.
Rule 8 pc override: the card returns to hand when the round gave no benefit.
